title: Frobenius–Perron dimensions of the join and intersection of commuting fusion subcategories
difficulty_reason: The existing regular-element and Perron facts are given. The new two-subcategory argument selects V containing all product supports, compares the product R_A R_B with the join regular element on the same strictly positive Perron direction, and recovers the proportionality scalar by the unit coefficient. This detects exactly the intersection and yields the full join/intersection dimension relation. Neither earlier functorial FPdim comparisons nor a single regular-object scaling supplies this normalization mechanism.
